description: Machine twin of the DELEGATED-MERGE-AUTHORITY packet assembled by tools/assemble_merge_packet.py. Three-language standard: LAW-A03 manifest text (human), module docstrings (AI), this file (machine).

branch.description: Head branch of the PR; the seat convention is the prefix before '/'.

independent_validator.description: Login of a different seat whose review/comment named the exact head SHA with a verdict; empty when none.

post_merge_report_planned.description: Whether the merge plan includes a post-merge report.

posted_to_1354.description: Legacy canonical field name. True when intent + scorecard + validation were posted on the coordination venue (live venue first, delegation-original venue as fallback).

seat.description: Builder seat derived from the branch prefix (or author login).

self_scorecard.description: False when no scorecard comment names the PR head; otherwise the builder's own scorecard: numeric score, whether it is evidence-backed (has a ## Evidence section), and whether the value calculus was run.

target.description: Base branch the PR targets (must be 'main' for delegation).

test_evidence.description: Human-readable basis of tests_green (check-run names, conclusions, run ids).

tests_green.description: Kernel-test check-run green on the exact head AND no failing check-runs.

title: Delegated Merge Authority packet (LAW-A03)
